a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than wait. I'm telling you openly instead of breaking the agreement behind your back.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said up front, I'm taking 4 now. If we survive the storm, I won't take any more. I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.
